description:
Collections borrowers take loans against, ranked: open loans and
principal, repayment rate, floor price and how many offers lenders
already hold, and gondi_url, its collection page. A collection and its
wrappers (CryptoPunks and its wrapped forms) are one row, under the
collection they wrap. Start here to find where to lend.

chain.description: Only this chain; every chain if unset.

currency.description: Count offers in this principal currency only; implies its chain. Ranking and outstanding principal cover every currency.
currency.title: Currency

name: list_lending_opportunities

offer_count.description: Loan offers held on the collection or its NFTs in the requested principal currencies.
offer_count.title: Offer Count

outstanding_principal_usd.description: Principal of the open loans in every currency, valued in USD; a currency without a USD rate adds nothing.
outstanding_principal_usd.title: Outstanding Principal Usd

repayment_rate_percent.description: Share of closed loans that were repaid; also 0 while no loan on the collection has closed yet.
repayment_rate_percent.title: Repayment Rate Percent

title: Lending opportunities
